acceptance_cmd:
set -euo pipefail
inj="$(./ops/injection_lint.sh --baseline-check 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$inj"
grep -Eq '^OK — [0-9]+ findings \(all within baseline of [0-9]+\)\.$' <<<"$inj"
i18n="$(./ops/i18n_lint.sh --report 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$i18n"
grep -Eq '\[i18n_lint\] total: 0 \(raw=0 return=0 fmt=0 missing_keys=0 en_cjk=0 plural=0 localized_calls=322\)' <<<"$i18n"
./ops/i18n_lint.sh --baseline-check
